question.problem:
A series RL circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of $8\,\text{V},$ a resistance of $20\,Ω,$ and an inductance of $4\,\text{H}.$
Find, rounded to two decimal places, the circuit's current after $0.02$ seconds given that the initial current is $2\,\text{A}.$

The current after $0.02$ seconds is
{{field-1}} amperes.
